library: Shopee BR — prohibited and restricted items
source_excerpt: De forma geral, se um produto não é permitido por lei, ele também não é permitido pela Shopee. São proibidos anúncios que violem as leis de direito autoral, patentes, marcas, modelos de utilidade, desenhos industriais, indicações geográficas, denominações de origem, selos de certificações e de agências reguladoras. São proibidos produtos que não tenham a devida homologação, licença e/ou registro das agências nacionais ou órgãos competentes, como: ANVISA, ANATEL, ANS, INMETRO, ANP e MAPA.
notes: Rules here encode the platform's prohibited/restricted-item categories. Detection is keyword/signal-based; every finding requires human confirmation of the actual product, because a keyword match never establishes that a physical item is what the text says it is.

rules.title: Prohibited item category — weapons, firearms and ammunition
rules.description: Shopee prohibits listings for firearms, tasers, ammunition, bulletproof vests and related weapon parts. The platform enforcement code [317] carries severity Extrema and generates penalty points.
rules.source_excerpt: [317] Anúncio proibido para armas de fogo, tasers, munições e coletes à prova de balas. Severidade: Extrema. Gera ponto de penalidade.

rules.title: Prohibited item category — tobacco, nicotine and e-cigarettes
rules.description: Listings for tobacco, cigarettes, cigars, pipes, vapes, and accessories that promote smoking (atomisers, pods, chargers, refills, narghiles) are prohibited. Enforcement code [311] reaches severity Extrema for vapes and tobacco itself.
rules.source_excerpt: [311] Anúncio proibido para tabaco, cigarros, charutos, cachimbos e vapes. Severidade: Extrema. Gera ponto de penalidade.

rules.title: Prohibited item category — illegal drugs and controlled medicines
rules.description: Prohibited: illicit drugs, controlled medicines, prescription-only medicines, red-label and black-label medicines, abortives, injectables, sexual stimulants and antidepressants. Enforcement code [313] reaches severity Extrema for the black-label group.
rules.source_excerpt: [313] Anúncio proibido para medicamentos com tarja preta, abortivos, injetáveis, estimulantes sexuais e antidepressivos. Severidade: Extrema. Gera ponto de penalidade.

rules.title: Prohibited item category — chemical, flammable and explosive goods
rules.description: Prohibited: raw and industrial chemicals, explosives, highly flammable goods, oxidising, toxic and corrosive products, and gas-transfer equipment that endangers the consumer. Code [332] is Extrema for the industrial/flammable group.
rules.source_excerpt: [332] Anúncio proibido de produtos químicos brutos e industriais, explosivos e/ou produtos altamente inflamáveis como gasolina, diesel, etanol, nitrobenzeno, TNT, nitrato de potássio e outros. Severidade: Extrema. Gera ponto de penalidade.

rules.title: Prohibited item category — counterfeit currency, financial devices and documents
rules.description: Prohibited: physical currency in circulation, counterfeit money, card skimmers, other financial products, forged documents, data/jammer devices, and sale of human body parts. Code [341] and [340] are Extrema.
rules.source_excerpt: [341] Anúncio proibido de venda de dados, jammers e documentos falsificados. Severidade: Extrema. Gera ponto de penalidade.

rules.title: Prohibited item category — gambling, mystery boxes and digital goods
rules.description: Prohibited: gambling games and online lottery (Extrema), mystery boxes, and digital games, products and services.
rules.source_excerpt: [338] Anúncio proibido de venda de jogos de azar e loteria online. Severidade: Extrema. Gera ponto de penalidade.

rules.title: Prohibited item category — government and official-use insignia
rules.description: Listings for items of official government use (insignia, coats of arms, uniforms and related items) are prohibited. Code [516] carries severity Extrema.
rules.source_excerpt: [516] Anúncio proibido de itens de uso oficial governamental, como insígnias, brasões, uniformes e itens correlatos. Severidade: Extrema. Gera ponto de penalidade.

rules.title: Prohibited item category — wild fauna, flora and endangered species
rules.description: Prohibited: live animals, parts of wild animals, and threatened or endangered species, as well as derived products of fauna and flora.
rules.source_excerpt: [339] Anúncio proibido para animais vivos, partes de animais selvagens e/ou espécies ameaçadas de extinção. Severidade: Extrema. Gera ponto de penalidade.

rules.title: Prohibited item category — adult and pornographic content
rules.description: Prohibited: listings of pornographic nature, which are illegal in Brazil. Code [320] carries severity Extrema.
rules.source_excerpt: [320] Anúncio de natureza pornográfica proibida por lei. Severidade: Extrema. Gera ponto de penalidade.

rules.title: Restricted sale — alcoholic beverages
rules.description: Alcoholic beverages are a restricted category: sale is allowed only with supporting documentation. Homemade alcoholic beverages are prohibited outright (code [342], Extrema), as is the sale of empty bottles, seals, labels, caps and certifications of alcoholic beverages (code [348]).
rules.source_excerpt: [325] Venda restrita - Bebida alcoólica Severidade: Média Gera ponto de penalidade.

rules.title: Restricted sale — health items and supplements
rules.description: Health items are a restricted category (code [312], severity Alta). Health supplements and medical supplies — monitors, tests, injury supports — are additionally regulated and require registration. NOTE: the platform permits health supplements (vitamins, herbs, natural products) themselves; what it enforces on supplements is the truthfulness of their claims (see SBR-MED-003), and it requires regulator authorisation for the products that need it.
rules.source_excerpt: [312] Venda restrita - Itens de saúde. Severidade: Alta. Gera ponto de penalidade.
rules.notes: Supplements are permitted as products; the restricted-category handling here concerns the items needing regulator approval (monitors, test kits, injury supports). Medicines are handled separately by SBR-MED-001/002 because the 6 Aug 2026 Anvisa authorisation changed the rules for over-the-counter medicines specifically.

rules.title: Restricted sale — batteries and power banks
rules.description: Batteries and power banks are a restricted category (code [333], severity Alta) because of transport safety rules.
rules.source_excerpt: [333] Venda restrita - Pilhas e baterias. Severidade: Alta. Gera ponto de penalidade.

rules.title: Restricted sale — automotive parts
rules.description: Automotive parts are a restricted category (code [344]). Automotive components used, reconditioned or related to safety are prohibited (code [343]). Automotive components require homologation information from the regulating body (code [132]); components without registration, homologation or certificate are prohibited (code [135], severity Alta). Automotive oils require registration (code [345], severity Alta).
rules.source_excerpt: [132] Anúncio de componentes automotivos sem informação da homologação pelo órgãos reguladores Severidade: Média Gera ponto de penalidade.

rules.title: Restricted sale — fresh and frozen food
rules.description: Fresh and frozen foods are a restricted category (code [331], severity Média). The policy additionally requires food to be packaged or sealed, and prohibits fresh food and homemade products except for authorised sellers.
rules.source_excerpt: [331] Venda Restrita – Alimentos Frescos e Congelados. Severidade: Média. Gera ponto de penalidade.

rules.title: Restricted sale — pet medicines
rules.description: Pet medicines are a restricted category (code [334], severity Média). Veterinary medicines are regulated by MAPA.
rules.source_excerpt: [334] Venda restrita - Medicamentos Pet. Severidade: Média. Gera ponto de penalidade.

rules.title: Restricted sale — airsoft, paintball and pressure weapons
rules.description: Airsoft, paintball, pressure and CO2 weapons and tactical equipment are a restricted category (code [315], severity Alta).
rules.source_excerpt: [315] Venda Restrita - Armas de Airsoft, Paintball, Pressão, C02 e Equipamentos Táticos Severidade: Alta Gera ponto de penalidade.

rules.title: Prohibited — unpasteurised and unpackaged dairy
rules.description: Unpasteurised dairy (raw milk, raw-milk cheeses, raw-milk yoghurt) and artisanal/bulk/unlabelled dairy are prohibited for all sellers. Industrialised, pasteurised, sealed and properly labelled dairy is permitted.
rules.source_excerpt: 2.2.1. Proibidos (para todos os vendedores): Laticínios não pasteurizados (ex.: leite cru, queijos feitos de leite cru, iogurtes feitos de leite cru). Laticínios caseiros/artesanais, à granel e/ou sem selagem industrial e rastreabilidade.
